name: Stephen Davenport

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Elizabeth Tubbs (b. 5 May 1802, d. 24 Mar 1862); eight children.

bioAdditions: Giles & Franklin say Stephen, youngest child of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport, was born on 14 Aug 1800 and died on 22 Aug 1882. On 5 May 1822 he married Elizabeth Tubbs (5 May 1802 - 24 Mar 1862). Their children were Hanford (d. 1865, m. Fanny Larned), Thomas M. (b. 1829, m. Diana Good), William (b. 1827, m. 1855 Adaline Harrison), Earl, Samuel, and Charity Adelaide (b. Town Line, Pa., 16/18 Feb 1839, d. Hicks Ferry 9 Sep 1930, m. Charles Good) (S1).

conflicts.foundValue: Giles & Franklin also give 'William [Pringle], married Elizabeth Tubbs' for a son of John and Phoebe Pringle
conflicts.assessment: Probably a slip in Giles & Franklin. Stephen's wife Elizabeth Tubbs has full dates; William Pringle's wife needs checking.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Exact dates and marriage from the family genealogy.

sources.citation: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport ... and his Descendants (1962), pp.322-323
sources.supports: birth, death, marriage to Elizabeth Tubbs, children
